summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn and the finished-time capture in rich/progress.py, the progress.elapsed default style, Palette.__rich__ in rich/palette.py, a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry, a new test_time_elapsed_column unit test, a coupled update of test_columns (column list and expected output), and tests/test_palette.py. Per instructions, no tests were run and nothing was committed. The test_columns expected output was derived by hand-tracing clock reads and checked by grep for bar widths (25 and 16) and elapsed cell count (12). Other existing tests were reasoned about but not executed.
